name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Fix: a newly-federated item's real codec/resolution/audio data (from ApplyMediaDetails/ToDto) was never actually being saved, on any source, Plex or Jellyfin - only ever appearing to fail silently as a 'falling back to a live probe' warning. The cause: MaterializeItem tried to save an item's media streams immediately, before ILibraryManager.CreateItems had ever persisted that item's own database row - and MediaStreamInfos has a foreign key on it, so the save reliably hit a FOREIGN KEY constraint failure for every item's first sync, every time. Confirmed live: hundreds of freshly-synced items hit this in one sync pass. The practical effect went beyond a log warning - falling back to a live ffprobe means using whatever the source file's own (sometimes wrong) container metadata says, e.g. a plain stereo AAC track whose internal title incorrectly reads 'Surround 5.1', which is exactly the kind of mislabeling this fix now avoids for anything synced from here on. Media streams are now saved only after the item's tier has actually been created. 257 tests, all green.
